title: 长句的结构
goal: 找出长句的主干；听后按结构还原整句。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、计分、自适应

body.p: 长句是在主干上加成分。常见的加法有四种：并列谓语、状语从句、定语从句、复杂名词短语。官方规格把这四种列为句子加长的方式。分析长句，先找主句的动作，再看加上的成分属于哪里。

body.box:
The assistant checks the meter.
The assistant checks the meter and records the reading.
The assistant who works at night checks the meter.

body.p: 第二句加了一个并列的动作。第三句的 who works at night 修饰 assistant，不是主句的谓语。主干用来理解句子；复述时修饰成分要全部保留。

cards.title: 四种加长方式
rows: 并列谓语
and、but 连接同一主语的两个动作，后一个动作前没有主语。
The operator opens the panel and checks the wiring.
状语从句
when、because、although 等连接完整分句。
The operator stops the test when the warning light appears.
定语从句
who、which、that 引出对名词的限定。
The operator who checked the wiring signed the form.
复杂名词短语
名词前后带修饰语。主语的单复数看中心词。
The detailed report on the faulty wiring is ready.
并列的层级
and 也可连接两个名词。先看 and 两边是什么词性。
The operator checks the cable and the socket.
从句的层级
从句有自己的主语和谓语。从句的动词不是主句谓语。
The cable that the operator replaced works properly.

cards.title: 主干与修饰语
rows: 确定主句主语
先找句子讲的对象。动词前最近的名词不一定是主语。
The box of spare parts is missing. → The box is missing.
确定主句谓语
从句里的动词先不算进主句谓语。
The lens that arrived yesterday fits. → The lens fits.
保留并列动作
同一主语后的两个动作都属于主干。
The clerk checked and signed the form.
接回条件或时间
连词和它的从句一起放回录音里的位置。
If the signal returns, the test will resume.
接回定语从句
定语从句紧跟在它修饰的名词后面。
The sensor that measures pressure needs a new battery.
接回名词修饰语
of、with 等短语按原顺序放回中心名词后面。
The list of approved materials is on the desk.

body.box: The assistant who manages the equipment checks each cable and replaces any damaged connectors before the session begins.

body.p: 主句主语是 The assistant，并列谓语是 checks 与 replaces。who manages the equipment 限定 assistant，before the session begins 说明动作发生的时间。

body.box:
Core: The assistant checks each cable and replaces any damaged connectors.
Full: The assistant / who manages the equipment / checks each cable / and replaces any damaged connectors / before the session begins.

body.p: Core 只用于分析，不是完整的复述。还原时把 who 从句接回 assistant 后面，把 before 从句放回句尾。

groups.text: The film reel that arrived this morning contains the revised ending.

items.stem: Which statement gives the main-clause core?
options: The reel arrived this morning.
The reel contains the ending.
The ending was revised this morning.
The reel was revised this morning.
items.why: that arrived this morning 修饰 reel，主句为 The film reel contains the revised ending。

groups.text: The team weighed the flour and recorded the amount before mixing.

items.stem: Which statement gives the main-clause core?
options: The team mixed the flour.
The team recorded the mixing time.
The team weighed the recorded amount.
The team weighed the flour and recorded the amount.
items.why: weighed 和 recorded 共用主语 The team，两个动作都属于主干。before mixing 是时间修饰语，即第四项。

groups.text: The collection of handmade puppets occupies the upper shelf.

items.stem: Which statement gives the main-clause core?
options: The collection occupies the shelf.
The puppets are handmade.
The collection contains handmade puppets.
The puppets are on an upper shelf.
items.why: 中心名词 collection 作主语，of handmade puppets 是后置修饰语。

groups.text: Although the water was cold, the swimmers completed the crossing.

items.stem: Which statement gives the main-clause core?
options: The water was cold.
The swimmers crossed cold water.
The swimmers completed the crossing.
The crossing took place in cold water.
items.why: Although the water was cold 是让步从句，主句主语和谓语为 the swimmers completed。

lines.text: The tutor who teaches sculpture has approved the new design.

items.why: who teaches sculpture 修饰人 the tutor，has approved 是主句谓语。

lines.text: When the bell rings, the ushers will close the side doors.

items.why: When 从句在前，the ushers will close 为主句；情态动词后为原形。

lines.text: The coordinator checks the roster and assigns each volunteer a task.

items.stem: Put the heard chunks in their original order.
items.why: checks 与 assigns 为并列谓语，and assigning 不符合录音和句法。

lines.text: The instructions for assembling the display are inside the package.

items.stem: Reconstruct the sentence from the recording.
items.why: instructions 是复数中心词，for assembling the display 是修饰语，谓语为 are。

groups.text: The trainee who sorted the mineral samples will update the catalogue.

items.stem: Which option identifies the main-clause core?
options: The trainee sorted the samples.
The catalogue contains sorted samples.
The trainee will update the catalogue.
The trainee will sort the samples.
items.why: who sorted the mineral samples 是定语从句；主句动作是 will update the catalogue。

groups.text: The diagram of the emergency exits shows the route through the annex.

items.stem: Which option identifies the main-clause core?
options: The diagram shows the route.
The emergency exits lead through the annex.
The route passes through the annex.
The diagram depicts emergency exits.
items.why: The diagram 是中心主语，of the emergency exits 修饰 diagram；谓语为 shows。

groups.text: The reviewer read the proposal and added comments after the meeting ended.

items.stem: Which option identifies the main-clause core?
options: The reviewer read comments after the meeting.
The reviewer ended the meeting and read comments.
The reviewer added a proposal after reading comments.
The reviewer read the proposal and added comments.
items.why: read the proposal 与 added comments 都是 reviewer 的主句动作，after 引出时间从句。

groups.text: Because the path was muddy, the surveyors carried the equipment by hand.

items.stem: Which option identifies the main-clause core?
options: The path was muddy.
The surveyors carried the equipment.
The surveyors traveled along a muddy path.
The equipment was carried by hand.
items.why: Because the path was muddy 是原因从句，主句为 the surveyors carried the equipment。

lines.text: The assistant labels each seed packet and records its origin.

items.why: labels 与 records 共用主语；its origin 是第二个动作的宾语。

lines.text: The microscope will remain covered until the demonstration begins.

items.why: until the demonstration begins 是时间从句，unless 会改变逻辑关系。

lines.text: The student who designed the survey has revised the final question.

items.stem: Put the heard chunks in their original order.
items.why: who 从句紧接 student；主句 has revised 的助动词须与录音一致。

lines.text: The replacement parts for the projector are stored beneath the counter.

items.stem: Reconstruct the sentence from the recording.
items.why: parts 是复数中心词，for the projector 不能改变谓语的数。
